reviewed_boundary.scope:
1. Scope and Applicability

Manufacture of complete general workshop/construction tools designed to be held during work and containing their own electric motor: drills/drivers, impact tools, portable saws, grinders and sanders. Declare one product function and motor/drive configuration per dataset. Corded products include their installed mains cord; cordless products use a declared bare-tool-body supply without detachable battery and charger. Integral non-removable battery tools are outside this bounded body-only rule.

Exclude pneumatic/hydraulic/non-electric tools, stationary machine tools, garden/forestry machinery, medical/food appliances, separately sold parts, detachable batteries/chargers, interchangeable bits/blades/abrasives, kit cases, customer operation and maintenance, workpiece production and end-of-life. A kit must split its independent products and shared packaging using measured foreground attribution; it cannot use total kit mass as tool M. No machining, drilling or fastening service reference is defined.
reviewed_boundary.covered: Complete corded tool or cordless bare body with integral electric motor, configured by one working function.
reviewed_boundary.excluded: Detachable battery/charger, integral-battery tools, consumables, cases, stationary/non-electric tools, garden/medical/food machinery and work services.
reviewed_boundary.market_state: New accepted complete declared tool body with retained lubricant and required guards/handles; independent kit products and shipping packaging excluded from net tool mass.

authored_review_metadata.semantic_boundary_decision: New general workshop/construction hand-held electric tool-body category. Distinguish corded installed-cord tool and cordless bare tool body; exclude detachable battery/charger, interchangeable consumables, kit cases, garden/forestry machinery, medical/food appliances, non-electric/pneumatic/hydraulic tools and fixed machine tools. No equivalent material PCR found; existing fixed machine-tool and lawn-mower records remain separate. Kit products are separated without mass pooling; old scaffold retained read-only and identity not promoted. Classification acceptance separate.
evidence_limitations: Manufacturer model manuals support architecture and supply examples only; current BOM, work orders and actual release-test specifications govern each foreground dataset.
No universal tool mass, lifetime, polymer recipe, motor technology, factory test consumption, machining loss or emissions factor prescribed.
Process cards are concrete starting exchanges; actual missing BOM parts, chemicals, wastes and providers must be completed before inventory completeness claims.

unresolved_flow_identities.selected_flow: Polyamide-6 granulate with 30% glass fibre by mass
unresolved_flow_identities.reason: Returned neat-polyamide or differently reinforced resin categories do not verify this PA6-GF30 supplied compound.
Returned ABS raw-resin identities are products, not this discarded molding trim waste.
Generic prepared steel blank does not verify gear geometry/alloy and actual supply boundary; agricultural or mixed-metal blanks are not equivalent.
Generic aluminium alloy or casting products do not identify the shaped gearbox-housing blank and delivered condition.
Search returned ferrous swarf, mixed alloy chips or recycling products rather than verified aluminium-alloy swarf of this delivered state.
Broad electrical-steel or motor categories do not verify the finished stator-stack geometry and included-part boundary.
Returned varnish/resin or liquid-coating categories do not verify the supplied motor-impregnation formulation and concentration.
Returned clean copper recycling, post-consumer domestic/imported scrap and municipal waste-wire identities do not establish manufacturing enamel-wire offcuts.
Returned optical-assembly solder or solder-with-flux does not verify this separately supplied SAC wire form/alloy boundary.
Returned resin/elementary compounds do not verify the formulated flux concentration and supplied solution state.

Search/direct product candidate is China production mix and lacks concentration specification; target neat solvent is geographically unrestricted. Optical-assembly product or elementary air/water identities are not substitutes.
